scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=@zn-apps/ui-core && npm run build --workspace=@zn-apps/storage
scripts.generate:icons: node shared/ui-core/scripts/generate-icons.mjs --profile shared && node shared/ui-core/scripts/generate-icons.mjs --profile app:zound-box && node shared/ui-core/scripts/generate-icons.mjs --profile app:kitchensink && node shared/ui-core/scripts/generate-icons.mjs --profile app:pwa-app2
scripts.build:icons: npm run scan:icons && npm run generate:icons
scripts.build:zound-box: cd zound-box && npm run build && npm run generate:icons
scripts.build:app2: cd pwa-app2 && npm run build && npm run generate:icons
scripts.build:kitchensink: cd kitchensink && npm run build && npm run generate:icons
scripts.build:all: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp index.html dist/index.html && cp sw.js dist/sw.js && npm run build:shared && npm run build:zound-box && npm run generate:icons --profile app:zound-box && npm run build:app2 && npm run generate:icons --profile app:pwa-app2 && npm run build:kitchensink && npm run generate:icons --profile app:kitchensink && cp -r zound-box/dist dist/zound-box && cp -r pwa-app2/dist dist/pwa-app2 && cp -r kitchensink/dist dist/kitchensink
